newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Colombia retail sales down 2.83 percent in 1996.
newsitem.headline: Colombia retail sales down 2.83 percent in 1996.

text.p: Colombian retail sales fell 2.83 percent in last year compared with 1995 because of a downturn in internal demand, the National Statistics Department said Thursday.
Sales fell 5.47 percent in December, traditionally a month of high retail sales, compared with November and were down 1.94 percent compared with the same month in 1995.
Retail sales performed best in the clothing, footwear and pharmaceutical sectors, the statistics department said.
